- 1 cup quinoa (rinsed)

- 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes (halved)  
- 1/4 cup cucumber (diced)  
- 1/4 cup feta cheese (crumbled, optional)  
- 2 tablespoons olive oil  
- 1 tablespoon lemon juice  
- Salt and pepper to taste
